connector.name: Calfeed
connector.registryDescription: Turn a written schedule into a live calendar link people subscribe to in Apple, Google, Outlook.
connector.summary: Hosted at calfeed.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.calfeed, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — mint a Calfeed access token at https://calfeed.ai/profile and send as 'Bearer cf_...'
